**Legionella incident, Building C cooling tower (resolved, one decision needed)**

A routine test on 29 September found Legionella at 1,200 CFU/mL. We notified the health department within 24 hours, disinfected and cleaned the tower, and returned it to service after a resample on 9 October showed no detection. No illness has been linked to the site.

The cause was a failed biocide dosing pump that the contractor missed during a monthly visit, and we were not told. The pump has been replaced. The contractor must now confirm each visit in writing and report any missed visit.

Costs total $7,350, and we plan to recover this from the contractor. **Decision needed: approve $4,800 for a dosing pump alarm.** Until it is installed, weekly manual checks are in place.
